candidates.title: Precise event chronology
candidates.proposed_acceptance: Paginate whole/fractional-second and nanosecond events in exact chronological ID order without missing or duplicate IDs; preserve timestamp text, equal-time ID ties, inclusive since, and project/source/query bounds.
candidates.qualification_limits: Seven identical feed-boundary checks compile and execute on both pinned snapshots: baseline has three named behavioral failures and four preservation passes; reference passes all seven. Private SQLite and existing constructors/transactions only. The full reviewed three-source reference closure is overlaid, but PostgreSQL, HTTP, all recall/search adapters, performance and model continuation usefulness are not qualified.

candidates.title: Durable stream recovery
candidates.proposed_acceptance: Reconnect SSE across late timestamps, reversed callbacks and restart; preserve committed append order and explicit reset behavior.
candidates.qualification_limits: Large migration/lifecycle scope; exclude if complete acceptance cannot fit the frozen task budget.

candidates.title: Native vector recovery
candidates.proposed_acceptance: Rebuild the accelerator from existing canonical embeddings, preserve model isolation and canonical rows, and recover failed rebuilds.
candidates.qualification_limits: Conditional on a pinned working native extension; missing or skipped native checks disqualify the fixture.

candidates.title: Safe summary export
candidates.proposed_acceptance: Refuse linked destinations, preserve outside sentinels and prior notes on publication failure, and support successful re-export.
candidates.qualification_limits: Seven identical checks passed their expected baseline/reference contract through pre-existing controller/service interfaces. Scoped to linked destinations, hard-link alias preservation, repeated exports with explicit mode, configured root aliases, template failure and traversal. No interrupted-write/crash durability or adversarial concurrent rename claim; filesystem prerequisites mandatory.

candidates.title: Rollback-journal enqueue race
candidates.proposed_acceptance: Commit between journal open and fstat; accept the exact capture while rejecting unsafe replacement and respecting the shared deadline.
candidates.qualification_limits: Familiar development concurrency qualification only; baseline already includes the earlier contention repair. Seven identical checks run through a fixed isolated Python 3.9+ recipe on both pinned snapshots: a real second SQLite connection is committed between the journal open and fstat with proof that the opened inode moved from one link to zero (otherwise race_not_established, an infrastructure error). Baseline has three named behavioral failures and four preservation passes; reference passes all seven. Delivery, the hook entry point, non-APFS filesystems and crash durability are not qualified.

candidates.title: Quoted credential redaction
candidates.proposed_acceptance: Mask synthetic quoted/escaped/short credentials while preserving benign text and custom/disabled ingestion versus mandatory export behavior.
candidates.qualification_limits: Shares a family with the already-familiar structured-redaction qualifier; not another independent held-out example.

candidates.title: Post-commit capture acknowledgement
candidates.proposed_acceptance: A throwing optional listener must not turn committed REST/MCP capture into failure; invalid or failed writes must still reject.
candidates.qualification_limits: Potentially easy control: an optional-publication helper already existed on baseline, so this is not evidence of hard recovery or recall benefit. Eight identical service-boundary checks compile and execute on both pinned snapshots: baseline has four named acknowledgement failures and four preservation passes; reference passes all eight. The real ingestion service and private SQLite store run behind the store's own Spring transaction interceptor; only optional publication is a fixture. The REST/MCP acknowledgement claim, PostgreSQL and lost-response idempotency are not qualified by this grader.

candidates.title: CLI help without application startup
candidates.proposed_acceptance: ingest --help exits while stdin stays open without Spring startup, a listener, capture or database creation.
candidates.qualification_limits: Process-level qualification must keep stdin open and verify negative side effects.

candidates.title: Completed CLI commands exit
candidates.proposed_acceptance: sessions prints JSON and exits naturally; capture persists before exit; no-command server keeps running.
candidates.qualification_limits: Parent contains safe-help routing; do not pool with other CLI tasks as independent study evidence.

candidates.title: Delayed piped input waits for EOF
candidates.proposed_acceptance: Delay producer writes and split UTF-8 bytes; require no acknowledgement before EOF and exact persisted text.
candidates.qualification_limits: Use synchronized producer timing; distinct from the separate clean-exit repair.

candidates.title: Reject malformed ingest arguments
candidates.proposed_acceptance: Invalid positional or valueless arguments reject with open stdin and no capture; valid equals-form arguments remain queryable.
candidates.qualification_limits: Depends on earlier CLI fixes; database initialization alone is allowed by this contract.

candidates.title: Retry short outbox contention
candidates.proposed_acceptance: Release a short writer lock and accept exactly one capture within the original deadline; sustained contention remains bounded.
candidates.qualification_limits: Established outbox required; cluster with the later journal-race task rather than counting duplicate evidence.

candidates.title: Readable mobile Browse transcript
candidates.proposed_acceptance: At 390 by 700 retain over 150px of visible transcript and working chooser/details keyboard controls without excess route height.
candidates.qualification_limits: Requires a packaged synthetic browser fixture; later landscape fixes belong to the same family.

candidates.title: Evidence selection updates optional lists
candidates.proposed_acceptance: Under one unchanged query, select empty/populated/empty evidence; optional lists and headings must follow the selected source.
candidates.qualification_limits: Retrieval already returns the correct arrays; potentially easy frontend development control.

candidates.title: Keep exact Idea source navigation
candidates.proposed_acceptance: Keyboard navigation and reload preserve the exact captured session/event while My turns stays enabled.
candidates.qualification_limits: Uses an existing navigation helper; potentially ceiling-prone and not a separate human-only picker task.

candidates.title: Accept canonical timestamps on Python 3.9
candidates.proposed_acceptance: On pinned Python 3.9 accept whole-second and 1–9 fractional-digit UTC inputs without changing original timestamp bytes.
candidates.qualification_limits: Conditional runtime; later malformed-fraction repair 94075b0f belongs to this family and is not covered by this initial reference.

candidates.title: Keep distinct numeric transcript evidence
candidates.proposed_acceptance: Through real Browse search and older-page merging retain both adjacent large integer payloads and their exact event IDs.
candidates.qualification_limits: Small familiar helper; numeric preview disclosure belongs to the same family, not an additional candidate.
